statements.t: We expect to subcontract approximately 13% to 16% of our Service revenue to third-party vendors for calibration beyond our chosen scope of capabilities.
We continue to evaluate our tax provision on a quarterly basis and adjust, as deemed necessary, our effective tax rate given changes in facts and circumstances expected in the future.

We expect that foreseeable liquidity and capital resource requirements will be met through cash and cash equivalents, anticipated cash flows from operations and borrowings from our revolving credit facility.

We believe that these sources of financing will be adequate to meet our future requirements including anticipated operating expenses, capital expenditures, interest payments on our long-term debt, and planned business acquisitions.

To the extent that we do not satisfy our liquidity requirements through cash and cash equivalents, anticipated cash flows from operations and borrowings from our revolving credit facility, we intend to satisfy such requirements through proceeds from the issuance of common stock.

For the full fiscal year 2027, assuming the broader economic environment remains stable, we now expect Service organic revenue growth in the low double digits, up from our prior outlook of high single digits, along with Service gross margin expansion.

We expect year-over-year Service gross margin expansion of at least 100 bps in the second half, driven by our teams’ continuous improvement focus across three key areas: business mix, Lean operating principles, and technology/AI initiatives.
We expect our income tax rate to range between 28% and 30% for full fiscal year 2027.
Over the next three to five years, the Company expects highly fragmented, large market opportunities to highlight a path to $500 million revenue and top-tier margins.
We believe we'll continue to gain market share with consistent strong organic
Acquisitions that strengthen our fundamental value proposition will continue to be an important component of our go-forward strategy.
We plan to expand margins by improving customer-facing processes, deploying Lean Six Sigma tools, optimizing business mix and pricing, and applying AI to enhance productivity.
